categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in oil and gas exploration, development, and production, including high-end oil exploration technology services. It holds exploration and production rights in multiple domestic and overseas oil blocks, providing integrated oilfield technical services and engaging in oil and gas production operations. Additionally, it offers seismic data acquisition, processing, and interpretation services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary advanced oil exploration technologies such as WEFOX high-precision seismic imaging, SinoGeoStar, and MAVORICK software platforms. It integrates seismic geology with artificial intelligence for enhanced exploration accuracy. The company also employs 3D seismic data acquisition, processing, and interpretation, along with advanced reservoir evaluation and enhanced oil recovery techniques like thermal and chemical methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Its main customers are large state-owned oil companies, notably China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC) and China National Offshore Oil Corporation (CNOOC). The company serves the upstream oil and gas sector, focusing on exploration and production in China’s major basins and offshore areas, as well as international markets including the United States and Mongolia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with key oil and gas blocks in the Bohai Bay Basin, South China Sea, and the Junggar Basin in Xinjiang. It also has overseas operations in the United States (Texas) and Mongolia. Its seismic data acquisition and exploration services cover both onshore and offshore regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the upstream segment of the oil and gas supply chain, focusing on exploration, development, and production of oil and gas resources. It also provides upstream technical services such as seismic data acquisition, processing, and reservoir evaluation, positioning itself as a comprehensive upstream service and production operator.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing integrated seismic-geological-engineering exploration methods, deepening AI and big data applications in oilfield development, and accelerating the transition from exploration to production. R&D focuses on seismic imaging technologies, reservoir characterization, and enhanced oil recovery techniques. The company also emphasizes developing smart oilfield platforms and expanding international exploration projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of crude oil produced from its exploration and production blocks, accounting for over 97% of total revenue. Additional income comes from providing oil exploration technical services and leasing activities. The company operates under production sharing contracts, earning revenue from its equity share in oil production and technical service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major Chinese state-owned oilfield service providers and exploration companies, including subsidiaries of CNPC, CNOOC, and Sinopec. It positions itself as a high-end, technology-driven integrated oil exploration and production company with proprietary technologies and a diversified portfolio of exploration blocks, including international assets, distinguishing it from traditional service-only firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 485.8 million, a slight increase of 1.1% year-over-year. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 52.8 million, the loss narrowed significantly compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets grew by 20% to over RMB 2.7 billion, reflecting increased investment in exploration and development. Cash flow from operations improved markedly, indicating enhanced operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary high-success-rate oil exploration technologies, integration of seismic data with AI, and comprehensive one-stop oilfield technical services. Its unique 'technology-for-equity' business model reduces exploration risk and capital requirements while enabling access to valuable oil and gas assets. The combination of advanced technology, integrated services, and strategic international assets provides differentiated value to customers and investors.
